name: jira-deck
title: Jira Deck
description: Browse the Jira boards you pick, with or without sprints, plus your issues and backlog, in a keyboard-first split view.
author: gibranbadrul

commands.name: board
commands.title: Board
commands.subtitle: Jira Deck
commands.description: See what your board is working on: the running sprint, the next sprint and backlog, or open issues on boards without sprints.

commands.name: my-issues
commands.title: My Issues
commands.subtitle: Jira Deck
commands.description: See the open issues assigned to you.

commands.name: backlog
commands.title: Backlog
commands.subtitle: Jira Deck
commands.description: See the issues in a board's backlog.

commands.name: manage-boards
commands.title: Manage Boards
commands.subtitle: Jira Deck
commands.description: Pin the boards you want to see and set the default.

commands.name: create-issue
commands.title: Create Issue
commands.subtitle: Jira Deck
commands.description: Create a Jira issue without leaving Raycast. Type the summary right in root search.

preferences.name: siteUrl
preferences.title: Jira Site
preferences.description: Your Jira Cloud site, like your-team.atlassian.net.

preferences.name: email
preferences.title: Email
preferences.description: The email you sign in to Jira with.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. It's stored by Raycast and only sent to your Jira site.
